tapeLine: Latest sourced close is Friday 16 October, led lower by AI and chip stocks: S&P 500 -1.1% to 7,659.44, Nasdaq -2.1% to 26,140.03, Dow -0.3% to 52,002.41, per AP (16 Oct). Both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq had their worst week since June. No Monday futures were found.
matters:
Friday’s selloff was concentrated in chips and AI-linked names: Micron fell 5.6% and Intel 5.8%, amid doubts about how long the AI infrastructure boom lasts, per AP (16 Oct). The Russell 2000 fell 1.7% to 2,721.37. Rising oil prices also drew attention to the inflation outlook, per a CNBC live report. Energy stocks rose and partly offset the Dow’s losses.

Weekly moves: S&P 500 -1.9%, Nasdaq -4.5%, Russell 2000 -3%, Dow +0.7%, per AP (16 Oct). The VIX closed at 19.99, its highest since 29 July, per the same coverage.

Invalidation: whether the S&P 500 holds below Thursday’s 7,744.81 close, now about 1.1% above Friday’s close, and whether chip weakness spreads beyond the sector.
alsoOnTape: Oil, gold and Treasury yield levels were not found with a dated source and are not carried. VIX closed at 19.99 on Friday, per AP (16 Oct).

regime.tag: Risk-off into the week: the S&P 500 is about 2.0% below its 7,811.54 record close of 9 October, after its worst week since June.
regime.sizing: No scheduled catalyst was confirmed for Monday; the 27-28 October FOMC is the next scheduled evidence.

secondOrder: Thursday’s rebound on a hot PPI was followed by Friday’s tech-led drop with oil higher: the inflation backdrop did not decide direction either day; sector-specific AI worries did on Friday. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior invalidation framing, whether the S&P 500 would reclaim 7,811.54 or keep falling yields, treated yields as the swing factor; Friday’s drop came from AI and chip stocks instead, with the S&P 500 -1.1% to 7,659.44, per AP.
The prior level held again: the S&P 500 did not reclaim 7,811.54 and closed Friday at 7,659.44, per AP.
Whether yields kept falling after the PPI print cannot be graded: no sourced yield levels were found.
The 27-28 October FOMC has not occurred.
